name: radar-360
description: Plataforma de cibersegurança pessoal: monitoramento de vazamentos, resposta a incidentes com LGPD e auditoria de rede local. Hack Brasil 2026, Trilha 06.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @radar/api" "npm run dev -w @radar/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @radar/api && npm run build -w @radar/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run agent:test
scripts.agent:test: cd packages/local-agent && python -I -m unittest discover -s tests
